headline: Need for Speed Underground 2
title: Need for Speed Underground 2 Facts | Bayview, Tuning, 11 Million Copies | Classic Games
video_script: Need for Speed Underground two came out in two thousand four, made by EA Black Box. It was all about tuning your car and street racing in the city of Bayview, with the story told like a comic book. Brooke Burke voiced Rachel, who guides you through the game. It sold around eleven million copies. What was your car in Underground two? Comment below!
description: Need for Speed: Underground 2 (2004, EA Black Box) - car tuning and street racing in Bayview, comic-strip story, Brooke Burke as Rachel Teller; around 11 million copies sold.
